schema.description: Inferred (all-source, Alex 2026-11-24): the default Jira work item priorities, highest first; administrators may customise them. Meanings as ATLASSIAN-JIRA-STATUSES-PRIORITIES-RESOLUTIONS states them.

priority.description: Inferred from ATLASSIAN-JIRA-STATUSES-PRIORITIES-RESOLUTIONS, 'Work item priorities'. Highest: This problem will block progress. High: Serious problem that could block progress. Medium: Has the potential to affect progress. Low: Minor problem or easily worked around. Lowest: Trivial problem with little or no impact on progress.
